VIROLOGY LAB PROTOCOLS

Viral Culture and Handling:
- BSL-3 containment required for Lassa and Ebola viruses
- All work conducted in Class II biosafety cabinet
- Viral stocks maintained at -80°C in 15% glycerol
- Standard viral titration via plaque assay on Vero E6 cells

Polymer Synthesis Guidelines:
- All polymerization reactions under inert atmosphere
- GPC analysis using THF mobile phase, polystyrene standards
- FT-IR confirmation of functional groups
- NMR analysis in deuterated solvents

Characterization Techniques:
- TEM sample prep: negative staining with phosphotungstic acid
- DLS measurements at 25°C, 90° scattering angle
- Zeta potential in 10mM KCl solution
- UV-Vis spectroscopy for conjugation confirmation

# International Conference Presentation Standards

## Scottish Conference Requirements
- Use British English spelling (colour, centre, analyse)
- SI units required for all measurements
- Figure captions below images
- References in Vancouver style
- Time limit: 20 minutes presentation + 5 minutes questions

## Technical Presentation Format
- Introduction: 2-3 minutes
- Methods: 5-7 minutes (detailed for reproducibility)
- Results: 8-10 minutes (clear data visualization)
- Discussion: 3-4 minutes
- Conclusions: 1-2 minutes

## Visual Guidelines
- Minimum 24pt font for all text
- High contrast colors (black text on white background)
- Maximum 6 bullet points per slide
- Chemical structures clearly labeled
- Error bars on all quantitative data

# International Conference Presentation Standards

## Scottish Conference Requirements
- Use British English spelling (colour, centre, analyse)
- SI units required for all measurements
- Figure captions below images
- References in Vancouver style
- Time limit: 20 minutes presentation + 5 minutes questions

## Technical Presentation Format
- Introduction: 2-3 minutes
- Methods: 5-7 minutes (detailed for reproducibility)
- Results: 8-10 minutes (clear data visualization)
- Discussion: 3-4 minutes
- Conclusions: 1-2 minutes

## Visual Guidelines
- Minimum 24pt font for all text
- High contrast colors (black text on white background)
- Maximum 6 bullet points per slide
- Chemical structures clearly labeled
- Error bars on all quantitative data

- Consider cross-linking density adjustment for controlled degradation
- Evaluate different PEG chain lengths for stealth properties
- Surface modification with targeting ligands for enhanced specificity
